preconditions.description: The first input integer is the bitwise-xor of the array elements.
The second input integer is the sum of the array elements.

postconditions.description: If no array satisfies the condition, output -1.
If an array satisfies the condition, output its length and its elements.

postconditions.expression: output[0] > 0 and output[1] != [] implies (output[1] XOR output[2] == u and output[1] SUM output[2] == v)
postconditions.description: The output array's elements bitwise-xor is u and its elements sum is v.
